item.title: Who Watches the Watchers? Trust and Accountability in Software Development
item.description: I left an earlier startup environment partly because I feared its people, workload, and working conditions would lead me to burnout. I burnt out anyway while balancing engineering work with part-time schooling. My life outside work was changing, too: I found myself no longer interested in dysfunctional relationships, while family relationships and responsibilities were shifting. I mention this as context for my own capacity at the time, not as an explanation of anyone else’s conduct at work.
